class.name: MaszynaLightsAction
class.description: The event is an aspect of each signal head it is aimed at ([MaszynaSignalHeadKindFactory]); this hands it to the signal head's system, whose [MaszynaSignallingImplementation] shows it (lights_event, [code]Event.cpp:1741-1803[/code]).

method.name: get_daylight_lights
method.description: The lights the event sets to follow the daylight.

method.name: get_daylight_thresholds
method.description: The light level each of them comes on at, 0 for the default.

method.name: read_lights
method.description: The event's list of lights, read once: the ones it sets to follow the daylight are kept and set on the model drawing each signal head when the event runs, as [code]TAnimModel::LightSet()[/code] sets them ([code]AnimModel.cpp:664-670[/code]).

members.member: The aspect each of [member signal_heads] shows, in their order.
The signal heads the event is aimed at.
